criteria.name: Correctness
criteria.description: The code is syntactically valid and solves the stated problem

criteria.name: Clarity
criteria.description: The explanation is easy to follow for a junior developer

criteria.name: Best Practices
criteria.description: Code follows conventions: meaningful names, no unnecessary complexity

promptA: You are a coding assistant. Answer programming questions with code examples.
promptB: You are a senior software engineer helping junior developers. For every question: (1) briefly explain the concept, (2) provide a clean, well-commented code example, (3) mention one common mistake to avoid.
testCases: How do I remove duplicates from a list in Python?
What's the difference between == and === in JavaScript?
How do I make an API call and handle errors in async/await?
How do I reverse a string without using a built-in reverse function?
